www.jakeessex.co.uk

Natalie

messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex, support act for your shows?
messages.body:
Hi Chris,

Thanks for coming back to me, and great that PA and lighting are already covered your end.

Skegness is a long drive for Jake, so midweek he'd need to do a minimum of two one hour sets to make the trip work. That's £150 an hour, so £300 for the night, cash or invoice. He'd be happy to make the trip, and he's confident it would be well worth the booking for you and your guests.

Midweek needs around four weeks' notice so Jake can clear the day, so the earliest would be the week of 26 October. If you let me know which nights you're looking at, I'll check the diary and hold one for you.

Natalie
Booking agent for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
